title: Edge browser profiles
whyItMatters: Each profile is a separate browsing identity. Profile names and the accounts signed into Edge show who used this computer and which work or personal accounts were linked.
source: Chromium user data directory docs (Edge uses the Chromium layout): https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: Matches the Preferences marker file so non-profile folders (Crash Reports, ShaderCache) are skipped. Looked for on this PC: exists.

cleanup.exportFirst: Export saved passwords from Edge Passwords and favorites from the favorites manager, so you keep both before the profiles go.
cleanup.signOut: In Edge, open Settings > Profiles, sign out, and turn off sync, so the account stops keeping this PC in step.
steps: Edge is part of Windows and usually cannot be uninstalled; in Edge open Settings > Profiles and remove each profile instead.
Delete the Edge user data folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes every Edge profile on this PC: history, saved logins, cookies, favorites and open sessions.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Sign in to sync Microsoft Edge across devices: https://support.microsoft.com/en-US/edge/sign-in-to-sync-microsoft-edge-across-devices
